svg.aria-label: Sequence diagram of a delete: Client, Node, Hot tier, Cold tier. The node creates a DEL entry, or amends a pending put or copy-back entry, or amends the entry the leader holds for a copy, or claims a handed-over delete, by compare-and-swap. It deletes the key in cold and then in hot. A fresh entry is deleted at once. A pending entry is handed to the leader as DEL PENDING with no wait. An entry the leader held, or a claimed one, is handed over and the node polls the entry until the leader releases it, then answers; past the deadline it answers 503.
svg.title: A delete: take or amend the entry, delete cold and hot, wait for the release if a copy is in flight
svg.text: A delete: take or amend the entry, delete cold and hot, wait for the release if a copy is in flight
Client
Node
Hot tier
Cold tier
0 DELETE key
refuse a reserved key
1 create the entry, create-only: (DEL, HELD, this node)
created: a fresh entry
EXISTS: read it, then CAS to (DEL, HELD, this node). (PUT, PENDING) or (CB, PENDING): an amend; the leader's own CAS to HELD now fails, so no copy
starts: no wait. (PUT, HELD, the leader): an amend of a copy that may be in flight: WAIT. (DEL, PENDING): a claim of a retried delete, whose copy
may still run: WAIT. A client's HELD entry, SEALED, or the CAS lost three times: 503 SlowDown.
2 cold DELETE key (always, at once; cold first, so a cold read cannot return what hot lost)
3 hot DELETE key
Each call is bounded by its own timeout and by the node's live_until, and is never retried. A call that fails or times out: CAS the entry to (DEL,
PENDING) and answer 503; the leader finishes the delete, and a retry claims it and waits.
4a fresh entry: delete the entry. Nothing is left for the leader,
so a delete then a re-put of the key never waits
4b amended from PENDING: CAS to (DEL, PENDING)
the leader rolls it forward and releases it; no wait
4c amended from the leader's HELD, or claimed: CAS to
(DEL, PENDING), then hot GET of the entry at each step of
the per-item back-off (1 s, doubling)
entry gone, or another op's entry: the leader has released
5 204 (after 4c: only now)
Past the request deadline in 4c (a frozen or stalled leader): 503, retryable; hot and cold are already deleted and the entry stays (DEL, PENDING).
While the delete is in flight a PUT of the key is 503 and a GET or HEAD may still return the bytes: the delete is not acknowledged yet. After 204
they are 404. If a 4b or 4c CAS fails the delete still happened. A delete of an absent key is a 204.
